prompt: A unified team competed in the 1992 Summer Olympic games. How many years old was the first leader of the largest member nation of that team at the time of the game?
answer: The largest member nation was **Russia**, whose first leader was **President Boris Yeltsin**. Born on **February 1, 1931**, he was **61 years old** during the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona.
